title: Profiling News Media for Factuality and Bias Using LLMs and the Fact-Checking Methodology of Human Experts
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' ability to predict news outlet factuality and political bias. While the criteria for political bias include topics with moral or ethical dimensions (such as abortion or gay rights), the paper does not benchmark the LLM's own religious or ethical values, nor does it evaluate its performance on theological or spiritual domains.
